derivation: from H58 (אָבֵל) and H4714 (מִצְרַיִם); meadow of Egypt;

occurrences.text: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians: wherefore the name of it was called Abel–mizraim, which is beyond Jordan.
